text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our third-year summer camp together
comes to
an end without incide—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've gone and done't now! I ended up
giv'n City a
real piece of my mind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw geez, just think'n about it's
embarrass'n! I'm
such a dingbat! Oh, I
can feel my face burn'n up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she did end up talking to Gold
City and,
before she knew it, gotten
carried away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City was talk'n to me like everything's

peachy-keen, so I was try'n t'do the
same, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't look like she's going to calm
down
anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to start running again
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I think I'd like to run alongside her.
